revisionReason: Round 1 proved that prose-level alignment was insufficient: active machine state, gate ownership, reciprocal math, and a runnable simulation input contract must also agree before the canonical freeze can pass.
clarifications: Acceptance R4 applies to unvalidated balance, economy and pacing hypotheses; fixed accessibility, safety and performance gates are not simulation candidates.
The active user sequence is Step 1 through Step 6. Engineering history may be retained only under an explicitly historical and inactive key.
Step 5 completes implementation plus automated and browser acceptance. Step 6 owns physical-iPhone evidence and only then may the full product-slice gate pass.

Same-maximum depth contributes zero Dawn currency and an empty new-reward-ID set yields zero. A genuinely unclaimed one-time achievement may award once at the same maximum without creating a repeat farm.

additionalRequirements.condition: PROJECT_STATUS exposes exactly the active six steps under its active preparation key; any retired ten-step record is explicitly historical and inactive.

A parsed, versioned simulation/candidate-v1.json defines every input required for purchases, combat, survival, shops, Dawn, offline progress, personas, decisions, rounding and seeds, and changing it invalidates all downstream simulation results.
Step 5 cannot claim the physical-device portion of Gate C; Step 6 runs the 180-second boss and 600-second soak on the same commit and deployment, and a failure returns the work to Step 5.

All active documents and machine state agree on S01-S09, 24-hour offline cap, guarded post-Dawn known-floor re-clear, 1.6-2.0 second transitions, 48/56 CSS-pixel touch targets, 8-pixel gaps, 400-450 millisecond hold threshold and 150-200 millisecond repeat interval.
Auto-dispatch begins immediately after the first tutorial tap is accepted; the initial interaction does not require repeat tapping to secure the first kill.
Dawn return-time and composite-speed ranges are mathematical reciprocals, and D10_pre and Net10 state their comparison points and denominators without an unsupported center value.
Offline U cannot be changed by equipped build, current coins, opened menu or a last-second loadout change; it is clamped and persisted on economy changes and visibility transitions.

Build and armament acceptance uses exact percentile formulas, switching-frequency and dominance rejection tests, compatible boss TTK bands, and a defensive rather than attack-only Guardian conversion.
The authoritative stable-ID registry includes cats, helpers, enemies, elites, boss, shops, support facilities, armaments and Dawn branches, with one namespace separator policy and read-only aliases.
Three independent critics re-check the corrected worktree and report no unresolved P0 or P1 blocker before Step 1 is marked PASS.

newFailureConditions: the simulator must invent a missing rate, count, cost, effect, policy or random distribution
a Step 5 completion claim depends on Step 6 physical evidence
an active machine-readable field contradicts the Markdown source of truth
a reset-speed statement is not reciprocal to its stated return-time range
an offline reward reference can be raised by a last-second state change
a weapon family is the dominant answer or switching becomes mandatory per-floor busywork
